extracted.name: Strawberry Banana Smoothie
extracted.description: This easy Strawberry Banana Smoothie recipe is sweet and refreshing and ready to drink in just 5 minutes. Enjoy it year round by using fresh or frozen fruit.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup almond milk (low-fat milk, soy or oat milk)
instruction_lines: Add all ingredients to a blender (if using frozen fruit, don't add additional ice). Blend until smooth. Add a splash of milk, to thin, or additional ice, to thicken, if needed.
categories: How to make a strawberry banana smoothie
